caption:
Can a racing rig use a VR headset instead of a screen? Yes. In our PC setup the Quest 3 is the screen. Stealth VR is $1,857 in full, $1,258 with a headset you own, and it needs a gaming PC. Prices are our estimates. We earn from qualifying purchases. #simracing #vr

The VR setup, part by part: https://roomracer.com/guides/first-sim-rig-gift?src=yt-answer
title: VR sim racing rig instead of a screen: what to order ($1,857)
